Facts: Defendant Wang3, as school cashier and accountant, used his position to misappropriate public funds (school funds) 10+ times, total 332,600 RMB, deposited into his bank account, used to buy stocks, later returned all money before investigation. He admitted.

This is classic "挪用公款罪" (embezzlement of public funds) or "挪用公款罪" (misappropriation of public funds). Since he is a public employee (school staff) handling public funds, the crime is "挪用公款罪".
